items.followUp: Define mass and state its SI unit.

rubric.why: Force is defined as a push or pull.
rubric.description: Defines force as a push or pull.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying force as a push or pull.

rubric.why: Inertia is the property by which a body resists a change in its state of rest or motion.
rubric.description: Defines inertia as resistance to a change in state.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that a body resists a change in its state of rest or motion.

modelAnswer: Force is a push or pull that can change or tend to change the state of rest or motion of a body.
Inertia is the property of a body by which it resists a change in its state of rest or motion.

items.followUp: Define power and write its SI unit.

rubric.why: Work is done when a force displaces a body in the direction of the force.
rubric.description: Defines work in terms of force causing displacement in its direction.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that a force causes displacement of a body.

rubric.why: Energy is the capacity or ability to do work.
rubric.description: Defines energy as the capacity to do work.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for defining energy as the capacity or ability to do work.

modelAnswer: Work is done when a force displaces a body in the direction of the force.
Energy is the capacity to do work.
